messages:
alex: Quick thank you to @sam for assembling the new 'Sticker Station' near the lobby — my laptop now has seven tiny mushrooms and I'm inexplicably more productive :mushroom: :sparkles:
sam: Ha glad it's making the rounds. Left a tiny note with sticker etiquette (please don't raid the glitter unicorns) and a donation jar for replacements.
jules: Also a shoutout to @karen for donating extra sticker packs and the mega roll of washi tape 10/10 generosity :heart: :tada:
karen: Happy to share! If the jar fills up we can either restock or put the extras into the community art box.
ops-bot: SUPPLIES: Sticker Station setup logged (SS-2026). Suggested reorder item: STICKER-PACK-XL. Vendor link: https://vendors.internal/supplies.
nina: Tiny poll: best sticker vibe? React with :mushroom: for 'quirky', :sparkles: for 'glitter', :robot: for 'techy'.
alex: :mushroom: (clearly)
jules: :sparkles: (glitter forever)
sam: Thanks again everyone 1 it's these small, weird rituals that keep things fun. I'll add a one-liner to the weekly roundup and a photo for posterity.
